name: TX-03
label: Likely R

key_factors: Incumbent Keith Self running with large fundraising edge
Polymarket prices Self at ~94% to win
No public polling of the race
model.rationale: TX-03's R+11 lean, Self's incumbency and roughly doubled fundraising, and prediction markets near 94% Republican all point to a comfortable Self win, with only modest uncertainty from the absence of polling.
model.watch: A late Democratic fundraising surge or outside spending, or a broader Texas shift, could narrow the margin.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Republican Keith Self seeks a third term in this Collin County-area district, which leans Republican by about eleven points. He enters the general election with a clear financial advantage, having raised more than twice as much as Democrat Evan Hunt and benefiting from outside support, while Hunt's campaign has limited cash on hand. No public polls have surveyed the race, and no expert raters have flagged it as competitive.

Prediction markets give Self roughly a 94% chance of winning, consistent with the district's fundamentals. The forecast expects Self to win by about thirteen points, though the lack of polling leaves some room for error in either direction.
